card.text: CoRoT-2 b was found in 2008 by CoRoT as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "CoRoT-2b"
sources.quote: CoRoT-2b is the second extrasolar planet to be detected by the French-led CoRoT mission, and orbits the star CoRoT-2 at a distance of 700 light-years from Earth towards the constellation Aquila.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around CoRoT-2. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2010's fit, the archive's default.
